validated_top_candidate.signature: Remove 100 m lateral digitisation-jitter shadow along interior mapped fault segments (d_cat <= 100 m AND d_end > 300 m AND cat_nbrs >= 2 AND d_euler > 300 m = 2,434 px on d=2.8), while explicitly preserving along-strike tip continuations (d_end <= 300 m: 1,360 px) and shallow Euler N=0 contact depth-cluster corroboration zones (d_euler <= 300 m: 143 px; 1,457 union protected pixels).

Along interior segments (cat_nbrs >= 2, d_end > 300 m) without an independent subsurface contact solution, a d_cat=100 m pixel is lateral digitisation halo on an already-mapped fault (0.0040 credit/FP, 4.8x below OOF break-even). At fault tips (d_end <= 300 m) or where a shallow Euler N=0 depth cluster corroborates a subsurface contact, the pixel marks an unmapped tip propagation or shallow buried splay (0.0092 credit/FP, 2.29x higher credit density).
validated_top_candidate.differs_from_repo: Prior H27-4 blindly pruned all 3,891 d_cat <= 100 m pixels on d=2.8 and was only shipped bundled with the now live-refuted T-v2 gap-closure dots (23ad46a4d7ba). This candidate uses retained SI=0 Euler depth clusters and catalogue tip geometry as a structural protection gate on d=2.8 with zero T-v2 drag.
validated_top_candidate.confounders: Catalogue-internal holdout overweights tip adjacency relative to isolated far-field faults; mitigated by reporting both H32-1 (protected) and solo H27-4 (unprotected) on d=2.8.

Remaining arms are therefore ranked ADD-first, and an ADD arm is validated on the far-field LOSFO harness (evidence/losfo_farfield_diagnostic.json), never on the interleaved holdout, which by construction holds out no off-catalogue habitat. Attribute transfer FROM mapped faults TO off-catalogue candidates is now on the do-not-revive list: only ~12% of emitted dots have a similarly oriented mapped segment within 1 km, a coverage ceiling no radius widening fixes. Session 14 (knowledge/37) ranks five distinct candidate rules; H38-1 combines shallow SI-0 Euler depth coherence, an independent gravity-gradient corridor, and low LiDAR relief. ranked_hypotheses.title: Shallow SI-0 Euler contact × independent gravity edge × low LiDAR relief
ranked_hypotheses.cost: Low–medium; local hash-pinned owner-mirror layers, no new external data
ranked_hypotheses.status: Label-free support READY (140); seeds 265–269 locally audited and reserved; holdout NOT RUN
layers: evidence/h31_1_euler_clusters.csv: SI-0 Euler solutions from training tmi, fixed depth_mad_m <= 60, median_depth_m <= 400, n_solutions >= 8
data/training_features.tif band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg: independent gravity field/gradient
data/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif bands 9 relief and 12 valid; catalogue only for exclusion/leakage controls
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A shallow, depth-coherent contact-like magnetic Euler cluster is corroborated by a nearby strong independently measured gravity gradient and subdued local relief; a buried density/magnetic contact under a surface without a strong scarp is the target, not proof of faulting or geothermal activity.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_catalogue: A buried or subdued structure can lack a mappable Quaternary surface trace while retaining subsurface magnetic and gravity contrasts. The relief condition targets that gap rather than high-relief mapped scarps; the competition statement says public fault labels are incomplete and experts added faults, but LOSFO is not organizer truth.
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H37-3 emitted on shallow SI-0 Euler depth coherence alone and missed the 0.0548 live-value bar. H37-2 proposed potential-field lineaments × low relief. H38-1 tests a narrower three-way Euler-depth, independent-gravity-gradient, low-relief conjunction; no score-guided threshold tuning.
ranked_hypotheses.data_gate: Label-free support READY at 140 unique centroids; local seed scan PASS_LOCAL_SCAN and exact-range claim RESERVED. This is not holdout validation; no fit has started.
ranked_hypotheses.main_confounder: SI-0 is an idealized contact geometry, gravity edges include lithologic contacts and basin margins, and relief is a quantized local descriptor; the conjunction can still select non-fault contacts.

ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A spatially supported thermal residual/probe anomaly aligned with a potential-field structural corridor, not merely proximity to a spring or warm well.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_catalogue: Buried alluvium-mantled faults can channel upflow and warm shallow ground without a preserved surface rupture; surface-fault compilations do not map a thermal residual.
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Distinct from failed H35-1 spring/well discharge-point proximity and from the earlier still-untested H33-3/H35-2 residual/probe concept; that older work means the broad idea is not globally new within this repository history.
ranked_hypotheses.data_gate: Official 124 MB heat-flow archive and GDR probe package are listed, but no local H38 clip/schema/coverage audit exists. Fetch, pin, inspect, clip, and freeze one rule before any seed use.
ranked_hypotheses.main_confounder: Sparse wells, hydrologic discharge unrelated to faults, and uncertain residual semantics can create apparent anomalies.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Paleogeothermal deposits × subsurface contact corridor
ranked_hypotheses.cost: Low–medium; small GDR package; clip and coverage/schema audit required
ranked_hypotheses.status: Queued; official source listing checked, not locally audited
layers: GDR #1391 paleogeothermal features: sinter, tufa/travertine and mapped spring-deposit features
Independent gravity/magnetic contact corridor
Low-relief context layer
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A paleo-fluid spring deposit spatially associated with a subsurface contact corridor and terrain consistent with partial burial or subdued expression.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_catalogue: Old or partly buried fluid pathways may leave deposits after current surface scarps become muted, so a Quaternary surface-rupture catalogue can omit the structure.
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Targets mapped paleo-deposits rather than H35-1 present-temperature/well discharge points; no deposit-by-contact conjunction has been tested here.
ranked_hypotheses.data_gate: GDR lists a small resource under CC BY 4.0; a listing/previous byte availability is not a local clip. Coverage, schema, coordinates and exclusions need audit.
ranked_hypotheses.main_confounder: Deposits are sparse and exposure-biased; age, preservation and non-tectonic spring pathways may dominate.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Drainage offsets, knickpoints and beheaded channels × potential-field lineaments
ranked_hypotheses.cost: Very high; 1 m DEM tile preflight and hydrologic processing required
ranked_hypotheses.status: Queued; product is official/public-domain, actual 716-tile coverage is unverified

Derived channel network, flow routing and geomorphic metrics
Independent potential-field lineaments and lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif for contrast
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Channel offsets, aligned knickpoint trains, beheaded channels, wind gaps or right-angle drainage deflections crossing an independently derived potential-field lineament.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_catalogue: Drainage can preserve young displacement after scarp relief is softened or buried; alluvial-basin faults may still perturb channel courses despite weak surface morphology.
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Prior LiDAR work uses amplitude/roughness/openness descriptors; no repository arm has tested flow-network topology or channel displacement metrics.
ranked_hypotheses.data_gate: The official public-domain 1 m product exists, but all 716 owner-mirrored tile URLs, coverage, CRS/datum, bytes and total volume remain unchecked. No seed until a complete tile preflight.
ranked_hypotheses.main_confounder: Lithology, drainage engineering, climate and DEM artifacts also create knickpoints and offsets; requires lineament concurrence and blinded geomorphic review.
